thread:
maya: Quick async check-in on token-cost attribution + latency breakdown + event schema. Are owners good to call this a canary readiness by EOD? cc @sam @rachel @josh

sam: On it — eventing PR (#4321) ready but waiting on a minor field rename. Pushed diff, requesting review from @josh.

josh: I'll take a look in a bit. FYI the latency sampler has a small bug — for short requests kv-cache isn't recorded; patching now, should be in staging by noon.

rachel: From product side, can we confirm token_count vs tokens naming? Analytics wants tokens (plural) across dashboards.

sam: We used token_count in model telemetry historically. If we change to tokens need backcompat shim in ingest; I can add aliasing.

maya: For rollout plan: once schema PR merged + ingest shim deployed + sampler fix in staging, we can enable attr-canary flag for 1% traffic. Please confirm ETAs:
- sam: schema PR merge ETA?
- josh: sampler patch ETA?
- rachel: product signoff?

sam: Schema PR is already approved, just renaming, I can merge by 10:30am PST after tests.

josh: Sam — once you merge I'll kick a staging deploy, patch completes at 11:15am PST. Will post deploy bot msg.

instrumentation-bot: deploy-staging: build 2026.03.17-1159 -> SUCCESS (staging)

rachel: signoff from me once staging ingest shows both token_count and tokens fields populated for sample user_id 1122. Can you paste sample event?

sam: Sample event:
```json
{
  "event": "inference.complete",
  "user_id": "1122",
  "model": "redwood-4x",
  "tokens": 42,
  "token_count": 42,
  "latency_ms": 123
}
```

josh: saw sample in logs — looks good. One minor ask: add latency_bucket field for quick rollups, e.g., "<50", "50-200", ">200".

maya: Adding latency_bucket to event schema would help dashboarding. Sam, can you add alias and new field before merge? Also add a migration note in the PR.

sam: Yep — adding alias + latency_bucket. Will include a short migration note and a CI smoke test that checks both fields present.

maya: Great. Final ask: once canary flag enabled please post summary with:
- token attribution samples for 10 requests
- token cost delta estimate
- latency breakdown by bucket

josh: I'll collect traces and post summary in this thread after canary.

rachel: :thumbsup: sounds good.

maya: Thanks everyone — updating the project board and tagging owners. If anything slips call out ASAP.
